name: Capacity Profiles
description: Agents have capacity profiles: max concurrent tasks, memory limit, CPU budget, token budget.
purpose: Prevent agent overload by modeling and enforcing resource capacities so the scheduler can make informed dispatch decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Capacity profiles are defined with max concurrent tasks, memory limit, CPU budget, and token budget
Profiles are registered at agent startup and queryable
Scheduler respects capacity when dispatching — never assigns beyond limits
Capacity usage is tracked and updated as tasks start and complete
Exceeding capacity triggers backpressure or queueing
Profiles can be updated dynamically without agent restart
